data.title: Cheatle forceps
data.summary: Forceps & clamps · Long L-shaped forceps without teeth or lock, kept in antiseptic to pick up sterile items.
data.body:
![Cheatle forceps](instruments/cheatle-forceps.jpg)

_Also called: Cheatle's sterilizer forceps, Transfer forceps_

Long L-shaped forceps without teeth or lock, kept in antiseptic to pick up sterile items.

## Parts
- Somewhat L-shaped arms without teeth or lock
- Proximal rings for thumb and ring finger (or one ring and a V-bend)
- Sinuous distal part with curved serrated jaws

## Uses / indications
- Picking up sterile instruments, gauze and dressing material from trays/drums

## How to hold
Thumb and ring finger in rings; keep tips pointing down so fluid does not run back onto the handle.

## Sterilisation & care
Distal part kept immersed in antiseptic (e.g. Savlon) in its jar; autoclave periodically.

## Viva points & tips
- Must be stored in a bottle of Savlon / antiseptic
- Never touch the patient with it
